findings.title: Menu identity repeatedly serializes complete unrelated user settings
findings.confidence: high source shape; actual CPU/heap unmeasured
findings.smallestOption: Replace full settings serialization with exact relevant primitive signature in shared owner; preserve authoritative server checks
alternatives: Share stable viewer/policy signature once per browser state revision without cross-request auth caching
acceptance: Actual long browse key evaluations/serialized bytes
Unrelated avatar/bio changes do not refetch

findings.title: Request dialog abandons option reads without aborting them
findings.confidence: high source lifetime; actual incidence unmeasured
findings.sharedOwner: existing abortable request-option/resource lifecycle and provider signal chain
findings.smallestOption: Route both option consumers through one existing abortable resource owner; extend shared upstream signal chain
alternatives: Narrow extension of current request controls rather than a new dialog-local algorithm
acceptance: Queued cancellation sends zero provider calls
Late result cannot affect new dialog; submitted writes retain acknowledgement

findings.title: Grouped recommendation responses refresh once per recommendation ID
